# MongoDB Murder Mystery

> A free, hands-on game for learning MongoDB queries. Players explore a real database, follow clues and name the killer of a
> murder in MongoDB City. Three tracks: a step-by-step walkthrough, solo play in a mongosh-style query box, and an AI Track
> where an LLM agent queries the database for you. Open source (MIT).

## Play
- [Home](https://mongomurdermystery.com/): the mission, the solo query box and the solution check
- [Walkthrough](https://mongomurdermystery.com/walkthrough): step-by-step lessons for people new to MongoDB
- [AI Track](https://mongomurdermystery.com/ai) (beta): ask an agent that can query the database in plain English
- [About](https://mongomurdermystery.com/about): goals, what you learn, limits, privacy and how it works

## Understand it
- [Repository](https://github.com/desteves/mongo-murder-mystery): source, issues and releases

## Contribute
- [Contributing](https://github.com/desteves/mongo-murder-mystery/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/desteves/mongo-murder-mystery/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Notes for automated clients
- The query API is for the website and requires its shared key; it is rate limited. Please do not scrape or load-test it.
- The solution is stored separately and can only be checked one suspect name at a time.
